changes.what: The two observed refusal classes now carry the oracle's own vocabulary instead of bare FAILED_code<N>: FAILED_E2_START (oracle E2: runtime_start_failed code=3, EXPECTED-REFUSAL, >= MINIMAL-ACCEPT) and FAILED_B7_MFA (oracle B7: mfa_activate_failed, EXPECTED-REFUSAL, FAIL with named cause, nothing downstream ran). A MINIMAL_ACCEPT_E2_REFUSAL verdict fires when a code=3 refusal coexists with the current session's sdiag conversion quartet (all 4 lmf_extent events + anchor_count>0 + intervals_found>0 + cfg events), no D6 line, no crash tail, and a fresh failed status whose detail matches the refusal — with the E4 'activated' O_TRUNC caveat printed (evidence-equivalence per LAUNCH10-RESULTS section 2). Bare FAILED_code<N> remains the fallback.
